userProfile.title: UserProfile
userProfile.description: User account profiles containing usernames, visual avatar assets, stats, and historical telemetry log entries.

avatarUrl.description: URL or asset reference to user's selected profile photo.

history.description: Chronological history array of user app actions.

savedProjectsCount.description: Total count of active documentation and index mappings.

followers.description: List of user UIDs who are following this creator.

following.description: List of user UIDs who this creator is following.

post.title: Post
post.description: A community feed entry with a title, description of creation, generated blueprint image reference, and interaction metrics.

likes.description: Array of user UIDs who have liked this community post.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: A single text comment linked to a community post.

/userProfiles/{userId}.description: Store individual accounts and social follow graphs.

/posts/{postId}.description: Active community feed posts with image attachments.

/posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Comments attached directly to corresponding feed items.
